definition.betrayalDesc: Surrendering to and betraying the nation during wartime or national crisis, thereby undermining the fundamental interests of the country.
definition.puppetOfficeDesc: Holding office in a puppet regime established by the invaders, issuing decrees and aiding the oppressors.
definition.aidEnemyDesc: Providing intelligence, supplies, manpower, or economic support to the invaders and assisting enemy military operations.
definition.harmCompatriotsDesc: Participating in the suppression of patriotic forces and righteous individuals, and harming innocent civilians.
definition.traitorPropagandaDesc: Conducting treasonous and surrenderist propaganda, promoting separatist ideology, and whitewashing acts of aggression on behalf of the invaders.
definition.title: Criteria for Defining Traitors
definition.footer: Determinations are based on historical evidence. Any individual meeting one of the above criteria may be included.

about.title: About the Archive
about.compilationText1: This archive is a historical database of modern-era traitors, covering defectors from the late Song, late Ming, late Qing, and the War of Resistance periods. It primarily records individuals who committed treason, served in puppet governments, or aided the enemy.
about.compilationText2: Inclusion criteria: Any individual with clear historical documentation and verifiable identity shall be included. Each record is annotated with its source, and modification/review records are automatically generated.
about.methodologyText1: The statistics on the homepage are computed through real-time aggregation. The total number of traitors, convicted individuals, children records, and descendant status records represent the counts of non-empty corresponding fields among all included entries.
about.methodologyText2: Statistical figures are dynamically updated as records are added. If a record exists, the count is displayed; when a record is deleted, the change takes effect immediately.
about.disclaimerText1: The content of this archive is compiled from publicly available historical records and is intended solely for historical research reference. Corrections are welcome for any factual errors identified, and will be verified and amended upon review.
about.disclaimerText2: Content submitted by users is the responsibility of the submitter. This archive reserves the right to review disputed content, and contributors are encouraged to cite their sources.
about.closing: May this record engrave the national shame,
about.closing2: and serve as a warning to future generations.
